rules.title: General Laws Part II, Title I, Chapter 186, Section 15B
rules.requirement: A lessor may not require more than first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit equal to first month's rent, and the cost of a key and lock at or before tenancy start. Deposits must be held in a separate interest-bearing Massachusetts bank account, with 5% annual interest (or the lesser bank rate) paid to the tenant, a signed receipt and a statement of condition given, and the deposit returned within 30 days of termination less itemized permitted deductions.
rules.key_value: Security deposit capped at 1 month's rent; interest 5% per year or lesser bank rate; return within 30 days
rules.penalty: Lessor forfeits right to retain any of the deposit; tenant awarded three times the deposit (or balance) plus 5% interest, court costs and reasonable attorney's fees.
rules.status_basis: Current text in the General Laws; 2025, 9 amendments effective August 1, 2025 extend the limits to agents and allow a regulated fee in lieu of a deposit capped at 1 month's rent.

coverage.summary: Applies to lessors of residential real property generally.

rules.title: General Laws Part II, Title I, Chapter 186, Section 15B (upfront payment limits)
rules.requirement: At or before the start of a tenancy, a lessor or agent may not require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay more than first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit of one month's rent, and the cost of a key and lock. Later demands for advance rent beyond the current month's rent are barred.
rules.key_value: Upfront payments limited to first month, last month, 1-month deposit, and key and lock cost
